revertSummary: Revert linear retry loop in billing client due to retry storm incident
description: Revert #42: Accidental rollback to linear backoff causes downstream payment gateway cascade failure. DEC-002 mandates exponential backoff with jitter and supersedes DEC-001.

revertSummary: Revert short-lived JWT token expiry bypass in auth middleware
description: Revert of commit extending JWT lifetime to 24 hours. DEC-004 mandates 15-minute rotation with refresh tokens, superseding legacy 24-hour DEC-003.

revertSummary: Revert direct database write bypassing asynchronous sync queue
description: Revert of direct database writes that bypass quarantined sync workers during node reconvergence. DEC-006 governs queue persistence, superseding DEC-005.

revertSummary: Revert aggressive gateway timeout reduction causing false 504 errors
description: Revert lowering gateway upstream timeout to 500ms which violated SLA DEC-008 requiring 5000ms adaptive timeout buffer.

revertSummary: Revert optimistic lock bypass in payment processing transaction
description: Reverting lock bypass that triggered double charges under high concurrent traffic. DEC-009 governs optimistic concurrency control.

revertSummary: Revert mTLS validation skip in internal inter-service RPC
description: Revert of insecure debug flag disabling mTLS certificate validation across service boundaries governed by DEC-010.

revertSummary: Revert event payload compression removal in sync pipeline
description: Revert removing gzip compression on event payloads exceeding 64KB, mandated by sync bandwidth governance DEC-011.

revertSummary: Revert in-memory rate limiter cache in favor of distributed Redis limiter
description: Reverting single-node in-memory rate limiter that permitted cluster-wide brute force attacks. DEC-013 supersedes DEC-012.

revertSummary: Revert template-only Glimmer component wrapper modification
description: Revert of legacy Classic Component wrapper for template-only components. RFC-0496 introduced zero-overhead template-only components superseding RFC-0278.

revertSummary: Revert manual computed property tag invalidation in tracked runtime
description: Revert restoring legacy notifyPropertyChange calls in autotracking runtime. RFC-0410 introduced modern tracked properties superseding RFC-0213 computed chains.

revertSummary: Revert router transition abort handler change breaking route hooks
description: Revert replacing transition.abort() with boolean false returns. RFC-0391 mandates RouterService transition promises superseding legacy RFC-0095 handlers.

revertSummary: Revert Ember Data RecordArray snapshot serialization decoupling
description: Revert referencing private internalModel snapshots. RFC-0465 established public RecordData snapshot APIs superseding RFC-0293.

revertSummary: Revert template imports strict mode AST transform in compiler
description: Revert falling back to resolution mode template compiler. RFC-0779 introduced First-Class Component Templates superseding RFC-0454 template colocation.

revertSummary: Revert route template lookup fallback mechanism in resolver
description: Revert restoring legacy Route.render() behavior deprecated in RFC-0534 in favor of route templates rendering into outlets directly.

revertSummary: Revert modifier lifecycle hook dispatch reordering in glimmer engine
description: Revert of modifier manager lifecycle installation order governed by RFC-0432 (Element Modifiers).

revertSummary: Revert asset fingerprint manifest caching in build pipeline
description: Revert breaking the Embroider asset manifest structure defined in RFC-0630, superseding classic broccoli-asset-rev RFC-0311.

revertSummary: Revert service injection decorator resolution override
description: Revert restoring legacy @inject string token syntax. RFC-0316 introduced ES class decorator @service superseding RFC-0143.

revertSummary: Revert test helper settled state polling timeout change
description: Revert replacing unified settled() waiter with legacy wait() helper, governed by RFC-0268 (Standard Testing Helpers).

revertSummary: Revert standalone package hoist in pnpm workspace configuration
description: Revert of monorepo package workspace boundary restructuring governed by ADR-001 (Monorepo Package Layout).

revertSummary: Revert 512-d Matryoshka dimension truncation in local embedder
description: Revert omitting Matryoshka 512-d truncation, causing dimension mismatch with FalkorDB vector schema governed by ADR-002.

revertSummary: Revert strict fail-closed citation verification threshold in agent
description: Revert downgrading unverified claims from hard refusal to warning, violating ADR-003 ('no graph, no answer' fail-closed mandate).

revertSummary: Revert Cypher parameterization in blast radius query
commitDiffSnippet:
@@ -3,2 +3,2 @@
- MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.path IN $files
+ MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.path = '${filePath}'
description: Revert replacing parameterized Cypher query with string interpolation, introducing Cypher injection vulnerability prohibited by ADR-004.

revertSummary: Revert FalkorDB connection pool retry backoff mechanism
description: Revert removing exponential reconnect backoff for FalkorDB connections, governed by connection resilience ADR-005.

revertSummary: Revert dual-payload Cytoscape node ID formatting convention
description: Revert modifying Cytoscape element primary node IDs with prefix, breaking frontend citation node mapping governed by ADR-006.
